text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"རིག་བྱེད་ནི་ངེས་བརྗོད་དང་སྲིད་སྲུང་དང་སྙན་དངགས་དང་མཆོད་སྦྱིན་ནོ། །","english":"The \"Vedas\" are the Rig Veda, Atharva Veda, Sama Veda, and Yajur Veda .","kind":"sense","why":"The source lists the four traditional Indian sciences (Vedas/Vidya), not the four specific Vedas.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: The "Vedas" are the Rig Veda, Atharva Veda, Sama Veda, and Yajur Veda .
contradictions.why: The source lists the four traditional Indian sciences (Vedas/Vidya), not the four specific Vedas.
